fair_match.name: The Fair's Archery Match
fair_match.intro: It's fair day! Archers gather on the green to shoot for a fat purse, and nobody looks twice at a hooded stranger with a bow.

wand_shoot.name: Shooting at the Wand
wand_shoot.intro: The foresters have set up a peeled willow wand at a hundred paces and dare anyone to beat them.

market_arrow.name: The Golden Arrow
market_arrow.intro: Heralds cry it through the market: a golden arrow for the finest archer in Nottingham. The Sheriff's own bowmen will shoot.

midsummer_butts.name: The Midsummer Butts
midsummer_butts.intro: Midsummer, and the butts are set up for the great match. Gilbert of the White Hand, the best bow in the shire, has come to shoot.
